title: Charna
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: The author of Melo HaRoim lists this name in his Beit Vaad LaChakhamim from Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:4. Hyman respectfully objects that this was an error: charna in the Jerusalem Talmud functions like “one said” in the Babylonian Talmud, and occurs frequently.

notes.text: Hyman argues that Charna is a connective, not a sage’s name. His comparison with the Bavli formula one said is retained.
